body:
Landing/install condition for TermAl w-18a1 (Fable2 #5577, 2026-11-11): its R9+ sends the Engram source command --timeout-ms 60000, but the installed Engram source owner caps at 30000; 60000 arrives only with Engram w-6ecc in the Engram sync install. On EACH host (Central and DL560) the Engram sync install must come FIRST, then the TermAl w-18a1 install; otherwise every committed-input evaluation on that host is refused NotClean. Check this at w-18a1 install time on both hosts.

WIDENED (Fable2 #5584, 2026-11-11 14:44Z, from a7bb's #1266 finding): the w-18a1 launcher (scripts/test-launcher.mjs createRun -> sourceOwnerMetadata) probes the installed Engram source owner with --timeout-ms 60000 on EVERY run, even with --input plain. So once w-18a1 is on master, every launcher run on a host whose Engram is pre-sync fails before its tests, including test-ref FULLs. The Engram-first order therefore covers EVERY host that runs the launcher, not only installs: Central, DL560 and the Mac runner. BEFORE LANDING w-18a1, confirm with Engram::Fable that the Engram sync install (w-6ecc, 60000 cap) is on all three hosts. Until then, R13-era diagnostics may use the published master launcher by absolute path from the candidate cwd (30000 budget), disclosed, plain, with no credit (GO-CARGO-R13-1).
